text:
Predicates:
PublishedBy(x, y) ::: x is a book published by y.
InLanguage(x, y) ::: x is in language y.
TranslatedFrom(x, y) ::: x is translated from language y.
Press(y) ::: y is a publishing house.
Specialize(y, z) ::: y specializes in z.
Premises:
Press(newVesselPress) ::: New Vessel Press is a publishing house.
∀x (PublishedBy(x, newVesselPress) → InLanguage(x, english)) ::: All books published by New Vessel Press are in English.
PublishedBy(neapolitanChronicles, newVesselPress) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles is published by New Vessel Press.
TranslatedFrom(neapolitanChronicles, italian) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles was translated from Italian.
PublishedBy(palaceOfFlies, newVesselPress) ::: Palace of Flies is published by New Vessel Press.
Conclusion:
InLanguage(neapolitanChronicles, english) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles is an English book.
